description: Full-text search over bill text, titles, and the labeled summaries. A bare bill number is a direct lookup. Search matches the words of the document: ask in the words the bill would use. `in_headings` searches only titles, topic tags, and subjects.

in_headings.description: Search only titles and headings instead of the full text.
in_headings.title: In Headings

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 40 (default 10).
limit.title: Limit

query.description: The words to search for, in the words the document itself would use.
query.title: Query

session.description: The session, named by its years or slug: 2025-2026 (the regular session) or 2026-special. Omit for the default the tool describes.
session.title: Session

name: bills_search
title: Search Georgia General Assembly bills
